name: The Shunammite Woman
title: The Woman Who Welcomed Elisha
summary: The wealthy woman from Shunem prepared a room for the prophet Elisha. As thanks, he promised her a son. When the boy later died, she went to Elisha, who raised him from the dead.

keyEvents.title: The Son Is Raised from the Dead
keyEvents.description: Elisha promised the childless woman from Shunem a son, and when the boy died, the prophet raised him from the dead.
